lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the fifth gill slit, following a longitudinal trajectory.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a coordinate-like grid on the lateral mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance (superior) to shadow (inferior), extending posteriorly from the dorsal margin of the gills.

other_distinctive_markers: Four small, elongated teleost-like silhouettes exhibiting high-contrast edges are positioned ventrally to the main pectoral fin.
